title: Twist and homogeneous-section comparison for a standard graded quotient
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}A_d$ and $B=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}B_d$ be nonnegatively graded commutative rings, with $A$ generated by $A_1$ over $A_0$, and let $\psi:A\twoheadrightarrow B$ be a surjective degree-preserving unital ring homomorphism. Put $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ and $X=\operatorname{Proj}(B)$ [def-pc-proj], and let $i:X\to P$ be the induced morphism [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality]. For a positive-degree homogeneous $f\in A$, one has $i^{-1}D_+(f)=D_+(\psi(f))$, and on these affine opens $i$ is induced by the surjective map $A_{(f)}\twoheadrightarrow B_{(\psi(f))}$ sending $a/f^r$ to $\psi(a)/\psi(f)^r$. Here $A_{(f)}$ denotes the degree-zero part of $A_f$, and similarly for $B$. For every $n\in\mathbf Z$, there is a canonical isomorphism $\theta_n:i^*\mathcal O_P(n)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_X(n)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. On the chart for $f\in A_1$, it sends the pullback of the basis $f^n$ to the basis $\psi(f)^n$, interpreted in the graded localized ring, also when $n<0$. The direct sum of these isomorphisms respects the unit and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O(a)\otimes\mathcal O(b)\to\mathcal O(a+b)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; for every $d\ge0$ and $s\in A_d$, it sends the pulled-back canonical section of $s$ to the canonical section of $\psi(s)$. These assertions include zero rings and empty standard opens.

source.place: Tag 01N1, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj, specialized to a surjective map; canonical graded-algebra comparison and chart/section formulas in lemma-morphism-proj.

proof.text: Apply Localization.localRingHom to values in the prime localizations. A homogeneous fraction of degree n maps to a fraction of degree n; zero maps to zero. Pull back a local fraction presentation to obtain a locally homogeneous fraction on the source. This defines a morphism O_P(n) to i_*O_X(n), linear for the actual structure map of Proj.map. Transpose using the section-normalized tensor pullback adjunction. Its value on i^*s is exactly the pointwise fraction map.

source.place: Tag 01N1, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj, specialized to a surjective map; canonical graded-algebra comparison and chart/section formulas in lemma-morphism-proj.

proof.text: The local fraction formula sends every degree-one frame f^n to psi(f)^n for all integer n. By isFreeGenerator_twistPowSection these are free generators. Pullback preserves free generators: identify tensorPullback with the usual pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, with the unit equation identifying the pulled-back sections, and use IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app. Consequently the comparison is bijective on all sections of every smaller open in such a chart.

source.place: Tag 01N1, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj, specialized to a surjective map; canonical graded-algebra comparison and chart/section formulas in lemma-morphism-proj.

proof.text: The degree-one charts cover P. If a prime p contains A_1, let q:A→A/p. The maps q and q composed with the degree-zero projection agree on A_0 and A_1, hence on A by the ring-generation hypothesis. Thus p contains the kernel of the degree-zero projection, namely A_+, contradiction. Pulling this cover back gives the degree-one image-chart cover on X. The local bijectivity in the preceding step proves the comparison is an isomorphism, by Hom.isIso_of_forall_bijective_app.

source.place: Tag 01N1, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj, specialized to a surjective map; canonical graded-algebra comparison and chart/section formulas in lemma-morphism-proj.

proof.text: The pointwise localization map preserves one and multiplication, so the comparison preserves the unit and the displayed products of all local sections. A canonical homogeneous section has pointwise value s/1; the comparison maps this to psi(s)/1, proving its section formula. These arguments include zero rings and empty opens.

source.place: Tag 01N1, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj, specialized to a surjective map; canonical graded-algebra comparison and chart/section formulas in lemma-morphism-proj.

proof.text: For uniqueness, compare the two homomorphisms in each degree on the degree-one image charts. Their values on the pulled-back free generators agree by the prescribed frame condition. Every local section is uniquely a scalar multiple of this generator, so the maps agree on all smaller opens by linearity and naturality. The sheaf axiom then gives global equality; Iso.ext and function extensionality give equality of the families.
